sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:27

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:27:1
items.html: The discernment of the vapour corresponding to the Ozen is missing, and only two vapours came out, which correspond to the Hotem and the Peh: That is to say, that only two vapours came out from the mouth of the Yesod, corresponding to the Hotem and the Peh, which are (44) a Vav to Ima and a point to Aba, as the ARI writes below. But the vapour of the Tabur, which corresponds to the light of the Ozen, did not reach AVI, for the reason that they have no hold except in the Hotem and Peh alone, as in the words of the ARI before us.
